答案:
第一題
📌 參考答案
A. R和W
A. R and W
📌 詳細解釋
根據圖示及生物學分類特徵，R（兔）和 W 均具有明顯的哺乳類特徵。
According to the diagrams and biological classification features, both R (rabbit) and W possess distinct mammalian characteristics.
哺乳類動物的主要特徵包括擁有乳腺以哺育幼體，以及體表長有毛髮。
The main characteristics of mammals include having mammary glands to feed their young and having body hair.
選項 B、C 和 D 中的其他動物（如魚類、爬蟲類或兩棲類）並不屬於同一分類群。
Other animals in options B, C, and D (such as fish, reptiles, or amphibians) do not belong to the same taxonomic group.
📌 考試提醒
哺乳類動物的獨有特徵是擁有乳腺及體表有毛髮。
The unique characteristics of mammals are having mammary glands and body hair.
常見錯誤：考生常因未能正確辨識圖中動物的特徵而選錯分類。
Common trap: Candidates often choose the wrong classification due to failing to correctly identify the features of the animals in the diagrams.

第二題
📌 參考答案
C. V
C. V
📌 詳細解釋
兩棲類動物（如 V）缺乏鱗片，並擁有濕潤的皮膚以作為輔助氣體交換的表面。
Amphibians (like V) lack scales and possess moist skin to serve as an accessory surface for gaseous exchange.
選項 A 錯誤，T（鱷魚）是爬蟲類，擁有乾燥的鱗片而非黏滑鱗片。
Option A is incorrect because T (crocodile) is a reptile and has dry scales rather than slimy scales.
選項 B 錯誤，U 是鳥類，特徵為擁有羽毛而非單純的足。
Option B is incorrect because U is a bird, characterized by having feathers rather than merely limbs.
選項 D 將兩棲類 V 錯誤地歸類為鳥類。
Option D incorrectly classifies the amphibian V as a bird.
📌 考試提醒
兩棲類動物必須保持皮膚濕潤，以作為輔助的呼吸器官。
Amphibians must keep their skin moist to serve as an accessory respiratory organ.
常見錯誤：考生未能分辨爬蟲類（乾燥鱗片）與兩棲類（濕潤無鱗片皮膚）的皮膚特徵差異。
Common trap: Candidates fail to distinguish the skin feature differences between reptiles (dry scales) and amphibians (moist, scaleless skin).

第三題
📌 參考答案
B. S和V
B. S and V
📌 詳細解釋
魚類（S）和兩棲類（V）通常在水中進行體外受精。
Fish (S) and amphibians (V) typically carry out external fertilization in water.
爬蟲類（T）、鳥類（U）和哺乳類（R 和 W）則進行體內受精，以提高精卵結合機會並適應陸地生活。
Reptiles (T), birds (U), and mammals (R and W) carry out internal fertilization to increase the chance of sperm-egg fusion and adapt to terrestrial life.
因此，只有選項 B 的配對是正確的。
Therefore, only the pairing in option B is correct.
📌 考試提醒
體外受精通常依賴水作為介質讓精子游向卵子，是水生或半水生脊椎動物的繁殖特徵。
External fertilization usually relies on water as a medium for sperms to swim towards eggs, which is a reproductive characteristic of aquatic or semi-aquatic vertebrates.
常見錯誤：考生混淆了不同脊椎動物組別的受精方式，誤以為爬蟲類也能進行體外受精。
Common trap: Candidates confuse the fertilization methods of different vertebrate groups, mistakenly believing that reptiles can also carry out external fertilization.

第四題
📌 參考答案
A. 菌類 藻類 裸子植物
A. Fungi, Algae, Gymnosperms
📌 詳細解釋
植物 (1) 沒有葉綠素，無法進行光合作用，屬於腐生或寄生的菌類。
Plant (1) lacks chlorophyll and cannot carry out photosynthesis, belonging to saprophytic or parasitic fungi.
植物 (2) 有葉綠素但沒有種子和花，符合藻類或蕨類植物的特徵。
Plant (2) has chlorophyll but no seeds and flowers, fitting the characteristics of algae or ferns.
植物 (3) 有葉綠素和種子，但沒有花，這正是裸子植物（如松樹）的獨有分類特徵。
Plant (3) has chlorophyll and seeds but no flowers, which is the unique taxonomic characteristic of gymnosperms (like pines).
📌 考試提醒
裸子植物能產生種子（通常在毬果內）但不會開花，而菌類並不屬於真正的綠色植物。
Gymnosperms produce seeds (usually in cones) but do not produce flowers, while fungi do not belong to true green plants.
常見錯誤：考生常以為所有能產生種子的植物都會開花，忽略了裸子植物的存在。
Common trap: Candidates often assume that all seed-producing plants will flower, ignoring the existence of gymnosperms.

第五題
📌 參考答案
D. (1)、(2)和(3)
D. (1), (2) and (3)
📌 詳細解釋
細胞核（1）負責控制神經元內所有的代謝活動及生長。
The nucleus (1) is responsible for controlling all metabolic activities and growth within the neuron.
神經元的軸突（2）是很長的延伸部份，專門用於長距離傳遞神經脈衝。
The axon (2) of a neuron is a very long extension specifically used to transmit nerve impulses over long distances.
樹突等末端分支（3）能大幅增加表面積，以便接收來自其他神經元或感受器的脈衝。
Terminal branches like dendrites (3) greatly increase the surface area to receive impulses from other neurons or receptors.
這三個結構特徵都是神經系統協調功能所必需的。
These three structural features are all essential for the coordinating function of the nervous system.
📌 考試提醒
神經元在結構上高度特化，長軸突與多分支的樹突是其快速及廣泛傳遞訊號的關鍵。
Neurons are highly specialized structurally; the long axon and highly branched dendrites are key to their rapid and widespread signal transmission.
常見錯誤：考生忽略了細胞核在維持神經元存活和功能協調上的基本作用。
Common trap: Candidates overlook the fundamental role of the nucleus in maintaining neuron survival and functional coordination.

第六題
📌 參考答案
A. 只有(1)和(2)
A. (1) and (2) only
📌 詳細解釋
保衛細胞（1）和葉肉細胞（2）均位於植物需要進行光合作用的見光部位，因此含有葉綠體。
Guard cells (1) and mesophyll cells (2) are located in light-exposed plant parts that need to carry out photosynthesis, hence they contain chloroplasts.
洋葱表皮細胞（3）來自生長於地下的鱗莖，平時無法接觸陽光，因此缺乏葉綠體。
Onion epidermal cells (3) come from the bulb growing underground, which normally cannot access sunlight and thus lack chloroplasts.
因此，只有選項 A 正確。
Therefore, only option A is correct.
📌 考試提醒
並非所有植物細胞都含有葉綠體，其存在取決於細胞的生長位置及生理功能。
Not all plant cells contain chloroplasts; their presence depends on the cell's location and physiological function.
常見錯誤：考生盲目背誦「植物細胞必有葉綠體」，忽略了地下器官（如根、鱗莖）的特化結構。
Common trap: Candidates blindly memorize that "plant cells must have chloroplasts," ignoring the specialized structures of underground organs (like roots and bulbs).

第七題
📌 參考答案
A. 花葯之內。
A. Inside an anther.
📌 詳細解釋
圖中顯示一個細胞經歷減數分裂後形成四個細胞（四分體），且具有明顯的厚細胞壁，這是植物產生小孢子的特徵。
The diagram shows a cell forming four cells (a tetrad) after meiosis, with distinct thick cell walls, which is characteristic of microspore production in plants.
在開花植物中，這過程發生在花葯內，形成的小孢子隨後會發育為花粉粒。
In flowering plants, this process occurs inside the anther, where the formed microspores will subsequently develop into pollen grains.
動物睪丸中的精子形成雖是減數分裂，但動物細胞缺乏圖中所示的細胞壁。
Although sperm formation in animal testes involves meiosis, animal cells lack the cell walls shown in the diagram.
📌 考試提醒
植物的花葯是進行減數分裂以產生配子的器官，而根尖和骨髓則主要進行有絲分裂。
The anther of a plant is the organ that undergoes meiosis to produce gametes, while the root tip and bone marrow primarily undergo mitosis.
常見錯誤：考生未能從厚細胞壁辨識出這是植物細胞，從而誤選了發生在動物體內的器官。
Common trap: Candidates fail to identify this as a plant cell from the thick cell walls, thus mistakenly choosing an organ where the process occurs in animals.

第八題
📌 參考答案
B. 只有(1)和(3)
B. (1) and (3) only
📌 詳細解釋
有絲分裂會產生兩個在基因上與母細胞完全相同的子細胞，故 (1) 正確。
Mitosis produces two daughter cells that are genetically identical to the parent cell, so (1) is correct.
染色體無論在有絲分裂還是減數分裂前，都只會複製一次，故 (2) 錯誤。
Chromosomes replicate only once before either mitosis or meiosis, so (2) is incorrect.
減數分裂產生的所有子細胞皆擁有相同數目的染色體（單倍體），故 (3) 正確。
All daughter cells produced by meiosis possess the same number of chromosomes (haploid), so (3) is correct.
📌 考試提醒
減數分裂涉及一次染色體複製及兩次細胞分裂，最終使子細胞的染色體數目減半。
Meiosis involves one chromosome replication and two cell divisions, ultimately halving the chromosome number in the daughter cells.
常見錯誤：考生誤以為減數分裂包含兩次細胞分裂，所以染色體也相應地複製了兩次。
Common trap: Candidates mistakenly believe that because meiosis includes two cell divisions, chromosomes are also replicated twice accordingly.

第九題
📌 參考答案
D. 生產者
D. Producer
📌 詳細解釋
食物鏈的第一個食性層次（最低層）始終是生產者，它們能透過光合作用將光能轉化為化學能。
The first trophic level (the lowest level) of a food chain is always the producer, which converts light energy into chemical energy through photosynthesis.
草食性動物進食生產者，屬於第二食性層次（初級消費者）。
Herbivores eat producers and belong to the second trophic level (primary consumers).
肉食性動物及雜食性動物則位於更高的食性層次。
Carnivores and omnivores are located at higher trophic levels.
📌 考試提醒
食性層次（Trophic level）由生產者作為第一層開始計算。
The trophic level is counted starting with the producer as the first level.
常見錯誤：考生常將「初級消費者」（草食性動物）誤當作「最低的食性層次」。
Common trap: Candidates often mistake the "primary consumer" (herbivore) for the "lowest trophic level".

第十題
📌 參考答案
A. 鐵質 - 甲狀腺腫
A. Iron - Goitre
📌 詳細解釋
缺乏鐵質會導致身體無法製造足夠的血紅蛋白，引致貧血而非甲狀腺腫。
Iron deficiency prevents the body from producing enough haemoglobin, leading to anaemia rather than goitre.
甲狀腺腫（大頸泡）是由於膳食中缺乏碘質，導致甲狀腺素分泌不足而引起的。
Goitre is caused by a lack of iodine in the diet, leading to insufficient secretion of thyroxine.
選項 B、C 和 D 的配對均是正確的營養素與其缺乏症對應。
The pairings in options B, C, and D are all correct corresponding nutrients and their deficiency diseases.
📌 考試提醒
鐵質是合成血紅蛋白的必需元素，而碘質是合成甲狀腺素的必需元素。
Iron is an essential element for synthesizing haemoglobin, while iodine is an essential element for synthesizing thyroxine.
常見錯誤：考生死記硬背各種缺乏症，卻將鐵質與碘質的生理功能互相混淆。
Common trap: Candidates rote-learn various deficiency diseases but confuse the physiological functions of iron and iodine.

第十一題
📌 參考答案
A. 國家 I
A. Country I
📌 詳細解釋
在累積條形圖中，每個項目的數值是藉由讀取該條柱區段的相對長度來決定的。
In a stacked bar chart, the value of each item is determined by reading the relative length of that specific bar segment.
代表「魚類」的是最右側斜線陰影的條柱區段。
The segment representing "Fish" is the rightmost bar section with diagonal shading.
透過比較四個國家的斜線陰影區段長度，國家 I 的區段最長，代表其每日耗用的魚類蛋白質最多。
By comparing the lengths of the diagonally shaded sections among the four countries, Country I has the longest section, indicating it consumes the most fish protein daily.
📌 考試提醒
處理累積條形圖時，每項目的實際數值必須以其區段的上限數值減去下限數值來求得。
When dealing with a stacked bar chart, the actual value of each item must be obtained by subtracting the lower limit from the upper limit of its section.
常見錯誤：考生未有看清圖例代表的食物種類，或直接讀取整條柱的總長度。
Common trap: Candidates fail to see clearly the food types represented by the legend, or directly read the total length of the entire bar.

第十二題
📌 參考答案
D. 國家 IV
D. Country IV
📌 詳細解釋
根據圖表，必須準確讀取代表「乳類製品」的白色條柱區間長度，並除以該國的總耗用量來計算比例。
According to the chart, one must accurately read the length of the white bar interval representing "Dairy products" and divide it by the country's total consumption to calculate the proportion.
國家 IV 的總動物蛋白質耗用量為 20 單位，其中乳類製品佔了 14 單位（18減4），比例高達 70%。
The total animal protein consumption for Country IV is 20 units, of which dairy products account for 14 units (18 minus 4), representing a high proportion of 70%。
其他國家的乳類製品比例均遠低於這個百分比，因此國家 IV 的比例最大。
The proportions of dairy products for other countries are much lower than this percentage, so Country IV has the largest proportion.
📌 考試提醒
題目詢問的是「比例」（Proportion）而非絕對數值，因此必須計算目標數值佔整體的百分比。
The question asks for the "proportion" rather than the absolute value, so it is necessary to calculate the percentage of the target value relative to the whole.
常見錯誤：考生只找出乳類製品絕對數值最大的國家（國家 I），而忽略了題目要求的是計算佔比。
Common trap: Candidates only find the country with the largest absolute value of dairy products (Country I) and ignore that the question requires calculating the proportion.

第十三題
📌 參考答案
D. 黃豆
D. Soya beans
📌 詳細解釋
黃豆屬於豆科植物的種子，其子葉內含有極高比例的植物性蛋白質作為儲藏養分。
Soya beans are seeds of leguminous plants, and their cotyledons contain a very high proportion of plant protein as stored nutrients.
菠菜富含鐵質與維生素，馬鈴薯主要儲存澱粉，而菇類的蛋白質含量則遠低於黃豆。
Spinach is rich in iron and vitamins, potatoes mainly store starch, and the protein content of mushrooms is much lower than that of soya beans.
因此，以每單位質量計算，黃豆含最大量的蛋白質。
Therefore, calculated per unit mass, soya beans contain the greatest amount of protein.
📌 考試提醒
在植物界中，豆類種子（如黃豆、花生）是人類攝取植物性蛋白質的主要來源。
In the plant kingdom, legume seeds (like soya beans and peanuts) are the primary sources for humans to obtain plant protein.
常見錯誤：考生常誤以為深綠色蔬菜或菇類含有最高量的蛋白質。
Common trap: Candidates often mistakenly believe that dark green vegetables or mushrooms contain the highest amount of protein.

第十四題
📌 參考答案
C. 只有(2)和(3)
C. (2) and (3) only
📌 詳細解釋
該頭骨顯示出草食性動物的典型特徵，包括缺乏犬齒以及擁有寬闊的齒缺。
The skull shows typical features of a herbivore, including the absence of canines and the presence of a wide diastema.
其臼齒表面平坦具脊，適合磨碎植物性食物如甘筍（2）和硬殼果（3），無法撕裂肉類或咬碎骨頭。
Its molars have flat, ridged surfaces suitable for grinding plant food like carrots (2) and nuts (3), and are incapable of tearing meat or crushing bones.
因此，食物 (1) 骨頭和 (4) 肉類並不適合此哺乳動物進食。
Therefore, food items (1) bones and (4) meat are not suitable for this mammal to eat.
📌 考試提醒
草食性動物的齒缺能容納長舌頭以攪拌植物，具脊的臼齒則用於機械性消化纖維。
The diastema in herbivores accommodates a long tongue to manipulate plant material, while ridged molars are used for the mechanical digestion of fibers.
常見錯誤：考生只留意到沒有犬齒，卻忽略了臼齒的咀嚼面特徵是否適合咬碎硬物。
Common trap: Candidates only notice the absence of canines but ignore whether the chewing surfaces of the molars are suitable for crushing hard objects.

第十五題
📌 參考答案
C. 膽鹽。
C. Bile salts.
📌 詳細解釋
膽汁中的膽鹽能將大脂肪滴乳化成微細的脂肪滴，這是一個純物理性的分解過程。
Bile salts in the bile can emulsify large fat drops into tiny fat droplets, which is a purely physical breakdown process.
乳化作用能大幅增加脂質的表面積，從而加快隨後脂肪酶進行化學性消化的速率。
Emulsification greatly increases the surface area of lipids, thereby speeding up the subsequent rate of chemical digestion by lipase.
膽汁本身並不含有任何消化酶，故選項 A 錯誤。
Bile itself does not contain any digestive enzymes, so option A is incorrect.
📌 考試提醒
膽汁由肝臟製造並儲存於膽囊中，其作用是改變脂質的物理狀態以輔助消化。
Bile is produced by the liver and stored in the gall bladder; its role is to change the physical state of lipids to assist digestion.
常見錯誤：考生誤以為膽汁內含消化酶，將乳化作用當作化學性消化。
Common trap: Candidates mistakenly believe bile contains digestive enzymes and treat emulsification as chemical digestion.

第十六題
📌 參考答案
A. 海產食物
A. Sea food
📌 詳細解釋
照片中的女子頸部明顯腫脹，顯示她患有甲狀腺腫（大頸泡）。
The woman in the photograph has a visibly swollen neck, indicating she suffers from goitre.
甲狀腺腫是由於日常飲食中缺乏碘質，導致甲狀腺無法製造足夠的甲狀腺素所引起。
Goitre is caused by a lack of iodine in the daily diet, leading to the thyroid gland's inability to produce enough thyroxine.
在四個選項中，海產食物是提供豐富碘質的最佳來源。
Among the four options, sea food is the best source for providing abundant iodine.
📌 考試提醒
缺乏碘質會導致甲狀腺分泌不足，進而引發甲狀腺組織的代償性增生擴大。
Iodine deficiency leads to insufficient thyroid secretion, which in turn triggers compensatory hyperplasia and enlargement of the thyroid tissue.
常見錯誤：考生只死記「缺碘導致甲狀腺腫」，卻不知道哪些常見食物含有豐富的碘質。
Common trap: Candidates merely rote-learn "iodine deficiency causes goitre" but do not know which common foods contain abundant iodine.

第十七題
📌 參考答案
A. 只分佈在上表面。
A. Only distributed on the upper surface.
📌 詳細解釋
睡蓮是浮水植物，其葉片的下表皮直接與水接觸，無法有效進行氣體擴散。
The water lily is a floating plant; its lower epidermis directly contacts the water and cannot effectively carry out gaseous diffusion.
為了確保光合作用與呼吸作用的氣體交換得以順利進行，其氣孔只集中分佈在接觸大氣的上表皮。
To ensure smooth gaseous exchange for photosynthesis and respiration, its stomata are concentrated only on the upper epidermis that contacts the atmosphere.
選項 B、C、D 的分佈模式皆不符合浮水葉的適應特徵。
The distribution patterns in options B, C, and D all do not match the adaptive features of floating leaves.
📌 考試提醒
氣體在空氣中的擴散速率遠高於在水中的擴散速率，因此植物氣孔通常面向空氣。
The rate of gaseous diffusion in air is much higher than that in water, so plant stomata typically face the air.
常見錯誤：考生忘記水生植物的氣體交換限制，誤以為水生植物不需要氣孔或氣孔均勻分佈。
Common trap: Candidates forget the gaseous exchange limitations of aquatic plants and mistakenly believe they do not need stomata or that stomata are evenly distributed.

第十八題
📌 參考答案
D. (1)、(2)和(3)
D. (1), (2) and (3)
📌 詳細解釋
